blocks.text: Walnut Grove homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Walnut Grove, September 2026. Detached houses: 43 listed at month end and 13 sold in September, a sales ratio of 30% (a sellers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 55 listed at month end and 10 sold in September, a sales ratio of 18% (a balanced market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, detached houses sold 64 over 4 months against an average of 47.5 listed, about 3.0 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 21 sold. condos and townhomes sold 62 over 4 months against an average of 52.8 listed, about 3.4 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 18 sold.
